gloss_en: Halakhah — the revealed corpus of Torah law (הֲלָכָה), paired contrastively with Kabbalah as its hidden counterpart; in Likutey Moharan 11 it corresponds to the Lower Unification (yichuda tata'ah), the weekday union, and the level of 'razin' (secrets), acronym of הָרִיעוּ לַה' כָּל הָאָרֶץ
